subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose indexed transcript persistence facts through the public Plugin SDK for bundled and external plugin consumers, or should this optimization wait for a different approved boundary?
rationale: The PR adds a durable plugin-facing API rather than only changing private mirror implementation, and repository policy treats Plugin SDK additions as compatibility-sensitive contracts.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Approve the generic indexed write-lock runner and its three facts as a supported Plugin SDK contract after current-head behavior proof is posted.

options.title: Defer the public surface
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define a preferred plugin-facing boundary for indexed transcript persistence facts.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Approve the generic indexed write-lock runner and its three facts as a supported Plugin SDK contract after current-head behavior proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged transcript foundation and authored the proposed follow-up, so they are the best available technical routing contact while a repository owner makes the contract decision.
